portInfo.description: ELIME (Association of Greek Ports) frames Katakolo as Pyrgos’s port, founded 1857, and today among Greece’s busiest cruise gateways specifically because of Olympia access. UNESCO’s Archaeological Site of Olympia sits in the Alpheios–Kladeos valley as the Altis sanctuary of Zeus and the Pan-Hellenic Games landscape — a separate inland destination, not a quay-side ruin.
